transport: Optional route and routeIndex fields in the existing checksummed selection-explanation envelope
membership: Maintained native route source IDs; no geometric regrouping or inferred electrical net
catalogue_binding: Existing source-role BINDING.json and its admission/roles gzip digests, matching the connection source and accepted-T03 scene

route_display.copper: Union of every current member body in maintained native order, preserving holes; bounded display derivative only
route_display.original_segments: Dotted open polylines from original native route_points_mm, not polygon edges or inferred skeletons
route_display.group_references: Existing durable straight/arc IDs, separate from native route IDs
route_display.segment_inspection: Original clicked source object and source identity retained; segment picker and Segment mode remain available

selection.fallback: Segment display with an explicit unavailability reason; never truncate a route
selection.picking: Active-layer priority, then catalogued trace membership ahead of covering context; repeat-click overlap cycling

bindings: Job and revision for index, route presentation and source explanation
Each member object/source identity and SHA256 of its displayed polygon path
Current and original WKB SHA256 per member
Catalogue artifact SHA256 and complete route membership
Object-order digest for compact picking indices: SHA256 of concatenated uint64-big-endian UTF8 byte lengths and object-ID bytes
derived_cache: Viewer-only compact membership, per-revision picking index and route presentation; source and construction files remain read-only
compatibility: Snapshots are unchanged; missing route fields retain existing source selection and comparison
